summary: The secure marḥablan clause has a first-person plural l-series agent suffix and reciprocal greeting understood from the encounter; no overt reciprocal object is printed.
The mrḥb entry explicitly classifies this denominal marḥaba verb as I; retain the supplied classification rather than reassign it because of its initial m-.

Allowed glossary lookup confirms rḥb III marḥable/marḥəb with begrüssen and a greeting example at 6/76, also cited under mrḥb I. The duplicate lexical treatment concerns alternative root/stem analyses; the new occurrence alone cannot determine which heading to retain.
Should denominal mrḥb I and rḥb III be cross-referenced or consolidated? They share forms, greeting gloss and 6/76. Do not delete either analysis without an editorial decision.
